assessments.reasoning: The title page identifies the authors and the JKU publication record connects this author copy to the 1991 paper. Fresh HTTP 200 yielded the retained complete PDF, SHA-256 8812e21426954c0e17100bd0e3f2ce0a5c24b8ef6cc8dbddb0bff12fdf8848e7. Checked page streams and rendered page witnesses. Printed p. 3 (physical PDF p. 3), §4 Declarations and scope rules, export-mark paragraph and IdentDef production; printed p. 7 (physical PDF p. 7), §8.1 Operands, designator paragraph. The declaration section identifies marked objects and importing modules. The operand section states read-only propagation through array and record selectors. The identifier remains exported with restricted client access. The separate selector rule carries the restriction to the two specified component forms. The exporter marks the variable or field with a minus in its declaration. The import-side restriction is evaluated in a module that imports the declaring module. The described restrictions concern importer access and the stated array and record designators. Pointer reachability and deep immutability require separate evidence. Reading IdentDef alone broadens the semantics to every declaration. The prose specifically names variables and record fields. The designator paragraph should never be extended to arbitrary pointer targets by implication.
